answers.core: Unity has the sprite editor sort of like an add-on. But as i was saying, making it core is no mistake, since its a critical feature for the sprite sheet workflow technique.
answers.workaround: If i would have been smart enough, i would have coded an addon myself, but i am not. Also, everyone will use it, i guarantee you. there's no way all gamedevs, be them indie or professional, prefer using separate png files for their 2D sprites
